title: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Reports during Secondment)
(1) Seconded judges, etc. shall submit an arrival report to the Minister of the National Court Administration within one month after arriving at the place of their secondment to an international organization, etc., and shall take necessary measures to ensure that they can be contacted at all times during the period of secondment.
(2) Where any of the following circumstances occurs, seconded judges, etc. shall submit the relevant document to the Minister of the National Court Administration:
1. Where their whereabouts or address changes: A report on the change of whereabouts (within 20 days after the change);
2. Where an illness, accident, or other change in personal circumstances affects the performance of their seconded duties: A report on the change in personal circumstances (immediately).
